title: Mac call-audio capture (system audio, macOS 14.2+)
summary: On macOS 14.2+ the call audio is now captured through Electron's built-in loopback, with a 2-second first-frame check that reports a missing permission instead of recording silence; the real Mac run is still owed because no Mac was available.
friction: parallel full suites from several Grillo sessions on one machine caused a false 5-second test timeout for another run; a shared gate lock (C:\wt\with-gate-lock.sh, lock dir C:\wt\gate.lock.d) was improvised mid-run and is not in the dev-next skill, so every brief had to be patched by message
lessons_learned: the in-flight file's 4-hour stale rule misfires for a long-lived session: another live run's entries stamped 06:22 were dropped at 11:20 as stale; stale should be judged by the claim's assignee and recent activity, not age alone

deferred.what: The permission instruction names Screen & System Audio Recording; whether macOS also asks for Screen Recording, and the exact pane name, are unconfirmed, so a host may be told to grant the wrong switch
deferred.why: Needs a real Mac run, which no machine in this run had
deferred.owner: unowned — next harvest (the Mac run owed on issue #106)
